description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Lexer_DOMLex, a PHP class that implements an HTML lexer using PHP's DOM extension. It handles tokenizing HTML input by parsing it into a DOM structure, then recursively converting nodes into tokens for further processing within the HTML Purifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Lexer_DOMLex
classes.description: A parser class that uses PHP's DOM extension to tokenize HTML into a series of tokens for HTML purification. It normalizes HTML, fixes stray brackets, wraps HTML in a full document structure, and recursively converts DOM nodes into tokens.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the lexer, setting up the token factory.

methods.name: tokenizeHTML
methods.description: Main entry point for tokenizing an HTML string. Normalizes the HTML, preprocesses it for UTF-8, loads it into a DOMDocument, and initiates recursive tokenization.

methods.name: tokenizeDOM
methods.description: Recursively traverses DOM nodes to generate tokens for each element, text, comment, or CDATA section.

methods.name: transformAttrToAssoc
methods.description: Converts a DOMNamedNodeMap of attributes into an associative array.

methods.name: muteErrorHandler
methods.description: Error handler that suppresses error output during DOM load.

methods.name: callbackUndoCommentSubst
methods.description: Restores escaped brackets in comment nodes.

methods.name: callbackArmorCommentEntities
methods.description: Encodes ampersands in comment nodes to prevent unintended parsing.

methods.name: wrapHTML
methods.description: Wraps the given HTML fragment with necessary DOCTYPE, html, head, and body tags for DOM parsing.
